rig.message: A needle jabs out of the lock!

disarm.text: On a failed check the creature sets it off.

rig.note: Poisoned for 1 hour on a failed save, which a fight's rounds cannot count: remove it when the hour is up. Opening the lock with a Knock spell or similar magic does not set it off.

rig.message: A weighted net drops from above!

find.what: the trip wire and the net

disarm.text: Once found, the trip wire can be cut or avoided, no check needed.

rig.note: The target succeeds automatically if it's Huge or larger: mark those Pass. Restrained until it escapes: an action and a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check frees a creature within reach. Reducing the net to 0 Hit Points frees it too.

rig.message: The floor gives way onto spikes!

disarm.text: Wedge an Iron Spike between the lid and the floor, or hold it shut with Arcane Lock.

rig.note: A 30-foot pit with spikes at the bottom. The lid stays open once it opens. Climbing out needs a Climb Speed, climbing gear, or magic such as Spider Climb.

rig.message: The statue breathes a cone of fire!

disarm.text: Wedge an Iron Spike under the pressure plate, or deface the glyph with a sharp tool.

rig.note: Place the 30-foot cone from the statue. It goes off when a creature moves onto the plate for the first time on a turn, or starts its turn there. Detect Magic shows an aura of Evocation around the statue, and a DC 15 Intelligence (Arcana) check reads the glyph as "fire".

rig.message: The ceiling comes crashing down!

find.what: the trip wire and the unstable ceiling

disarm.text: Once found, the trip wire can be cut or avoided, no check needed.

rig.note: Draw the squares under the unstable ceiling: everyone there is hit. Rubble from the collapse turns the trapped area into Difficult Terrain.
